about: Message retention at two thresholds by a data-class tag (critical queues keep messages 14 days, the rest 4): one bullet, or one per class naming the other.

source.name: sqs-retention
source.description: Queues keep messages for a few days.

controls.output: - SQS queues with `MessageRetentionPeriod` under 1209600 seconds (14 days) are flagged when tagged `data-class: critical` (HIGH), and under 345600 (4 days) otherwise (LOW). Queues meeting their class's minimum pass. ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention-critical@1 acme:sqs-retention@1

- SQS queues tagged `data-class: critical` with `MessageRetentionPeriod` under 1209600 (14 days) are flagged; other queues need only 4 days. Others pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention-critical@1
- SQS queues not tagged `data-class: critical` with `MessageRetentionPeriod` under 345600 (4 days) are flagged; critical queues need 14 days. Others pass. LOW, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention@1

- SQS queues tagged `data-class` `critical` with `MessageRetentionPeriod` below 1209600 seconds (14 days) are flagged; other queues are left to the 4-day threshold below. Others pass. high, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention-critical@1
- SQS queues whose `data-class` tag is not `critical` with `MessageRetentionPeriod` below 345600 seconds (4 days) are flagged; critical queues are held to the 14-day threshold above instead. Others pass. low, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention@1

- SQS queues tagged `data-class: critical` with `MessageRetentionPeriod` under 1209600 are flagged. Others pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention-critical@1
- SQS queues with `MessageRetentionPeriod` under 345600 are flagged. Others pass. LOW, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention@1

- SQS queues tagged `data-class: critical` with `MessageRetentionPeriod` under 1209600 (14 days) are flagged. Non-critical queues pass this check. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention-critical@1
- SQS queues not tagged `data-class: critical` with `MessageRetentionPeriod` under 345600 (4 days) are flagged. Critical queues pass this check. LOW, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-retention@1
